links.outcome: Decision changes after adding labels or pressure cues without changing clinical findings
links.effect: Additions changed 13.4 more decisions per 100 than neutral wording for the decision models and 14.0 for the LLM.

links.outcome: Framing-induced decision changes and triage accuracy after pairing decision model with LLM
links.effect: Pairing reduced changes to 2.6 per 100, about 81% lower in development and 42% to 48% lower in held-out reports; triage accuracy stayed near 81% to 82%.
links.quote: Pairing reduced this to 2.6, about 81% lower in development and 42% to 48% lower in held-out reports.
